records.claim: \paragraph{Multi-agent failures, attribution and noise.} Failure taxonomies \citep{cemri2025mast}, attribution of failures to agents and steps \citep{zhang2025whichcauses,chen2026seeingwhole}, the information-bottleneck view of when coordination helps \citep{yu2026when}, and the noise-floor protocol for small coordination gains \citep{kaliyev2026muchcoordination} inform our design: the item is the unit, controls are byte-identical, draws are near-replicates reported as such, and the concurrent family's verdicts are attributed to the worker's own change.
records.evidence: This perspective explains when bounded inter-agent communication helps or hurts.
